# Overview of Week 13 through Week 15

## Week 13 - Data Analysis (11/19)

- Hypothesis testing (Ch17–18)
  - t-tests, ANOVA, Chi-square, regression
  - SEM - Direct and mediation effects
- GP: Data analysis and final revisions
- Milestone 6: Looker Studio Dashboard

## Week 14 - Report Preparation (11/26)

- No class - Thanksgiving
- Finalize CEP report (Ch1–3) and slides
  - Formatting, grammar, appendices
  - Links to data, scripts, survey, Zotero

## Week 15 - Final Proposal Defense (12/3)

- Final presentation and report (Ch1–3)
- IRB approval and OneDrive data link
- Portfolio website submission
  - 2–3 minute recorded presentation

## Assignments on SEM

- M15-SEM & Hypothesis Testing with Case 31
- H1–H5: Factors affecting attitudes, civic consciousness, subjective norms, and behavioral control
  - Demographics, cognition, social engagement
  - Civic consciousness as mediator
- H6–H8: Purchase intentions
  - Attitudes, subjective norms, behavioral control (+)
- H9–H10: Moderation
  - Age strengthens, civic consciousness weakens relationships

# Review Qualtrics Assignment #1-2

- make edits
- submit to IRB

# Presentation

- Written report: Ch1–3 (CEP 01–12)
- 20 minutes, ~20–25 slides
  - PO vs. AO, client background, industry, SWOT
  - Research framework and data sources
  - Analytical methods for each AO
  - References and appendices
- Grading
  - At least 1 AO per member
  - PO-to-AO alignment, methods, data sufficiency
  - Credible sources
- Oral presentation
  - Storytelling over statistics
  - Connect research, methods, and insights
